data.narrative:
Krevera is a Seed-stage robotics and manufacturing company founded by Edward and Sebastian Schneeweiss, having raised $3M+ to date. The broader Robotics & Manufacturing sector comprises one public comparable (277810.KQ) and eight private peers including Walden Robotics, Divergent, Exotec, Locus Robotics, and Generalist AI.

Stage-progression analysis is the applicable valuation method here. Using the $3M total raised as a proxy for current enterprise value and applying a 2.5x multiplier typical of Seed-to-next-stage progression, this method implies a valuation of $8M. A peer-median approach is not applicable due to insufficient comparable datapoints; while 10 same-sector peers exist, only one operates at Krevera's stage, falling short of the three-company minimum threshold needed for robust statistical inference.

The triangulation yields a median valuation of $8M, with a low-end bound of $6M (15% discount) and high-end bound of $9M (15% premium) reflecting execution risk and stage-typical variance. Key uncertainties include the composition and exit multiples of the private peer set, the applicability of stage-progression multipliers to this specific subsector, and whether the $3M raised figure appropriately anchors pre-revenue or early-revenue positioning. A fuller peer set and clearer comparable exit data would improve confidence in this range.
